predecessors.name: Argentine Confederation
predecessors.text: the whole Argentine state of 1929, handed to Cliopatria's Argentine Republic row

ledger.x: 1930: Cliopatria's Argentine Republic row begins on the same land; one state, not a founding.
1936: Cliopatria's Argentine shape adds three cells north of Formosa that its 1930 Bolivia shape held.
1936: Cliopatria's Argentine shape drops three cells on the Paraguay and Pilcomayo frontier to Paraguay.
2 April 1982: Argentina invades and occupies the Falkland Islands.
14 June 1982: the Argentine garrison surrenders at Stanley.

wars.name: Falklands War
wars.outcome: British victory: Argentina occupied the islands from 2 April and surrendered on 14 June 1982, 'which formally returned possession to Britain'.

certainty.note: The land frontiers are river and treaty lines ('sharing land borders with Chile across the Andes to the west'); the pages opened give no dated treaty (page silent).
